entities.summary: Aka Morchiladze is the pen name of Giorgi Akhvlediani, a Georgian writer and literary historian who authored some of the best-selling prose of post-Soviet Georgian literary fiction. Morchiladze's work shows reorientation of the early 21st-century Georgian literature towards the Western influences.
